description: This file defines an interface for configuring JavaScript message mapping within the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for retrieving and setting scripts and library load options, as well as a builder interface for configuration.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for JavaScript message mapper configuration, providing methods to retrieve scripts and library load options.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: Builder interface for configuring JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration instances, allowing setting scripts and library load flags.

methods.name: getIncomingScript
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the incoming message mapping script.

methods.name: getOutgoingScript
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the outgoing message mapping script.

methods.name: isLoadBytebufferJS
methods.description: Determines whether to load the bytebuffer.js library.

methods.name: isLoadLongJS
methods.description: Determines whether to load the long.js library.

methods.name: incomingScript
methods.description: Sets the incoming message mapping script in the builder.

methods.name: outgoingScript
methods.description: Sets the outgoing message mapping script in the builder.

methods.name: loadBytebufferJS
methods.description: Configures the builder to load the bytebuffer.js library.

methods.name: loadLongJS
methods.description: Configures the builder to load the long.js library.
